About Aida

Aida Cheraghalian, founder & CEO

Aida Cheraghalian founded Owj Real Estate in 2024 on a simple conviction, set out in her own CEO message: a brokerage should be built on transparency, professionalism and real client success — not pressure to close. She leads a team of area specialists, keeps every deal visible through technology, and runs Owj as a referral-driven company: relationships over transactions, long after the keys are handed over.

How Buying Works

From first call to the peak, in four steps

01

Strategy

A direct conversation with Aida's team: budget, goal, timeline — and an honest read of the market.

02

Selection

A shortlist of Dubai's finest fits — off-plan launches or ready homes — with private viewings arranged.

03

Negotiation

Owj negotiates on your side and handles the paperwork — terms, contracts and compliance, in order.

04

Closing

Transfer, handover and keys — and a team that stays with you after the deal, for renting or reselling.
